sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Tagged and Cursed is a hidden player state in Escape from Tarkov.

It automatically applies to PMCs that don't have at least a firearm and an armor vest or a chest rig or a backpack equipped upon entering a raid.

sections.heading: Effect
sections.text: When PMCs are tagged and cursed, Scavs will actively go after them, knowing their exact location in an approximately 150 meter radius. Equipping gear in a raid will remove the state.

sections.heading: Practice mode
sections.text: The practice mode offers the possibility to purposely activate the tagged and cursed state regardless of the equipped gear.
